sentimento.text1: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED AGAIN, from 5.45pp to 9.25pp, and both sides moved: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 51.95% to 53.75% (vol USD 10.82M accumulated) and Lula fell from 46.50% to 44.50% (vol USD 11.16M accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 15. Neither price is an extreme: the 53.75% sits 1.35pp below Flávio's series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and the 44.50% sits 23.00pp below Lula's high, of 67.50% on Aug 16, and 10.00pp above his floor, of 34.50% on Apr 25.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ ONE NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED ON Sep 16, DATATRENDS, AND IT COMPLETES A TRIO IN TWO DAYS. By automated telephone, with fieldwork from Sep 12 to 14, 2,000 interviews and a margin of 2.19pp, it gives the first round to Lula by 39% to 35% and the runoff to Flávio Bolsonaro by 45% to 44%. ⚠️ Indexa/Broadcast, also by telephone and released on Sep 15, measures the same runoff pair with the same 1-point distance and the opposite sign, 43% to 42% for Lula, and both fall inside one margin. CNT/MDA, in person and from the same Sep 15, measures 7.3 points for Lula. The panel records all three without choosing.
sentimento.text3: 📅 THE REGISTRY OF THE SUPERIOR ELECTORAL COURT lists eleven national polls with a release date after today, and five of them fall on Sep 17: PoderData, Gerp, 100 Cidades, AtlasIntel and Datafolha. The 40,500-interview Veritá is set for Sep 18, two Palver waves for Sep 20, and Quaest, Nexus and American Analytics for Sep 21. ⚠️ The American Analytics poll that the previous calendar set for today left the Court's registry, and the house has another registration, for Sep 21. A registration is a commitment to release, not a published number.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 53.75% in the winner contract, up 1.80pp against the confirmed reading of Sep 15, 1.35pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he has 35% in the first round and 45% in the runoff against 44% for Lula, inside the margin. In the first-round runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp, to 75.50%.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 44.50% in the winner contract, down 2.00pp against the confirmed reading of Sep 15, and 23.00pp below his series high, of 67.50% on Aug 16. In the Sep 16 DataTrends poll he has 39% in the first round, ahead, and 44% in the runoff against 45% for Flávio Bolsonaro, inside the margin. In the first-round runner-up contract he rises 2.00pp, to 23.85%.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury has 6% in the first round of the Sep 16 DataTrends poll and gives up 0.20pp in the winner contract, to 0.25%. In the first-round third-place contract, which gets a new price in this round, he remains the favorite at 45.50%, up 0.10pp against the value published on Sep 14, while Renan Santos falls 1.00pp, to 36.50%, and Ronaldo Caiado stays at the same 15.50%. In DataTrends, Renan Santos has 4% and Caiado 3%.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT (15:41 UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and certification is per book: in this round all five tracked contracts were confirmed, winner, runner-up, first-round third place, Supreme Court impeachment and Senate. Presidential book at USD 150.50M accumulated.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT IN THE INSS FRAUD INQUIRY ON Sep 16. What still applies is the Sep 12 act, in which Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases, without changing their rapporteur.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 What links the INSS to the Master case here is procedural, not factual: both sets are suspended by the same decision, and the trial the full court opened on it on Sep 15 was suspended by Flávio Dino's request for more time to review the case, with no decision.
inss.impactoLula: The structured reading of government approval is still the Genial/Quaest poll of Sep 14, with fieldwork from Sep 10 to 13: 43% approve, 50% disapprove and 7% do not know, and on the management scale 32% positive, 27% fair, 38% negative and 3% no answer. The national polls of Sep 15 and 16 do not bring approval confirmed by two independent sources, so the panel does not replace it.
inss.impactoGestao: Within Quaest itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on Aug 05, 46% against 48% on Aug 14, 45% against 48% on Sep 02, 43% against 50% on Sep 07 and 43% against 50% on Sep 14. The 5-point fall in approval over about a month stopped in the latest round. ⭐ On the management scale, the Sep 14 release brings 32% positive rating, 27% regular and 38% negative, with 3% not answering, and that is the breakdown the block now uses, with a single date.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the topic is evaluation and calendar, not acts: there is no new act in the INSS fraud inquiry on Sep 16, and the trial on the suspension that reaches those cases stopped at a request for more time to review on Sep 15.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 THE FULL SUPREME COURT SUSPENDED ON Sep 15, WITH NO DECISION, THE REVIEW OF WHETHER TO INVESTIGATE ALEXANDRE DE MORAES over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio Dino asked for more time to review the case, which gives him up to 90 days to return it, and the justices did not reach the main point, which is whether the investigation should be opened (Gazeta do Povo and Poder360).
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 THE TIMELINE THE RECORD SUPPORTS: on Sep 12 Fachin took over as rapporteur and suspended the cases; on Sep 14 the Federal Police delivered to the chambers the full data extracted from Vorcaro's phone, André Mendonça lifted the seal on the data about the Banco Master payment network and Moraes filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate dismissal of the investigation; on Sep 15 the full court opened the trial and Dino asked for more time to review it, after sending Fachin, before the session, a request to investigate possible links between Mendonça and Vorcaro. ⚠️ Vorcaro's testimony to the Federal Police is rescheduled for Sep 24, at the request of his defense. Vorcaro is held at the Papudinha, in the Federal District.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page is from the reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT. In that reading the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.85%, with USD 91 thousand accumulated, 0.10pp below the 4.95% of Sep 15 and with the same accumulated volume as the previous day. It is a thin book, and the panel does not attribute the move to the request for more time to review.
bancoMaster.conclusao: What changes from Sep 15 to 16 is the timeline, not the merits: with no decision by the full court, the question of investigating Moraes can stay with Dino for up to 90 days, and Vorcaro's testimony remains set for Sep 24. The panel records the procedure and the price, without saying which of the two better describes the outcome.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on Sep 16. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos.
stf.moraes: On Sep 15 the full court discussed whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, and the review was suspended by Flávio Dino's request for more time, with no decision on opening the investigation. On the night of Sep 14 he had filed with Fachin a 121-point petition asking for the immediate dismissal of the investigation.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act confirmed by two independent sources on Sep 16. On Sep 14 his chamber received from the Federal Police the full data extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone.
stf.dino: On Sep 15 he asked for more time to review the trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the review for up to 90 days. Before the session, he sent Fachin a request to investigate possible links between André Mendonça and Daniel Vorcaro.
stf.mendonca: On Sep 15 Flávio Dino sent Fachin a request to investigate possible links between him and Daniel Vorcaro. On Sep 14 he had lifted the seal on the data about the Banco Master payment network, after a request from Fachin and a favorable opinion from the Prosecutor General's Office.
stf.nexo: The link to the election is one of calendar and institution, not of outcome. On Sep 15 the full court suspended, with no decision, the review of whether to investigate a justice, and the deadline of the request for more time is up to 90 days. In the Sep 16 reading the contract that pays out if a Supreme Court justice leaves by impeachment before 2027 stands at 4.85%, 0.10pp below the previous day and with no new money in the book. The panel does not claim the procedure moved the price.
stf.analise: 🏛️ THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 4.85% (vol USD 91 thousand accumulated), confirmed reading of Sep 16, 12:41 BRT, 0.10pp below the 4.95% of the confirmed reading of Sep 15. ⚠️ The accumulated volume is the same as the previous day, so today's move happened with no new money in the book. It remains 21.25pp below the series high, of 26.10% on Sep 11, and 2.75pp above the floor, of 2.10% on Jun 8.
stf.fachin: On Sep 15 he opened, as rapporteur, the full-court trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes, saying that "people are not judged; facts and legal questions are judged". The session ended with no decision, with Flávio Dino's request for more time to review.
